messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout paused for release v3.2.1-canary (deploy id: d-907). Reason: EU region error-rate spike (502s). Holding rollout and draining new traffic from canary nodes. /cc @diana @marco

marco: saw the spike on the dashboards, correlated to ingress upstream timeouts. I've scaled down canary traffic and started collecting logs.

diana: thanks. do we need to pin the canary to the previous stable while you investigate? want to avoid flapping for customers.

laura: product note: no customer-facing incidents yet, only internal alerts. prefer pin if it's quick.

tony: +1 pin to v3.2.0 for canary. if it's a config regression, rollback is safer than forced forward.

chris: quick repro locally pointed to an nginx header timeout mismatch in our helm template. small fix ready; can push as a patch but that needs a deploy window.

marco: plan proposal:
• pin canary nodes back to v3.2.0
• rollback ingress config on canary to stable template
• run smoke tests (health, kv-cache, token service)
• if green after 30m, re-run canary with patched config at 10% steps

deploy-bot: Suggested commands:
```bash
# pin canary deployment to stable image
kubectl set image deploy/canary-deploy api=my-registry/redwood:v3.2.0 -n prod-eu
# apply stable nginx values.yaml to canary ingress
helm upgrade ingress-prod ./charts/ingress -f values/ingress-stable.yaml --namespace prod-eu
```

ops-bot: Scheduled change window proposal: move release window from 02:00 UTC to 03:30 UTC to allow rollback + validation. change_window_id=cw-782

diana: can @marco own rollback and smoke validation? if ETA <30m i'll approve the window shift. also note: update release notes with the temporary pin.

marco: I'll own it. starting rollback now, ETA ~20m for smoke tests.

deploy-bot: Actioned: pinned canary to v3.2.0 (deploy id: d-908), holding any new rollouts.

chris: applying stable ingress template to canary now. will watch logs for 502s.

laura: i'll patch release notes: add a line about temporary canary pin due to ingress timeouts and link to incident channel.

marco: smoke tests passing on canary (health, kv-cache, token service). no 502s in the last 5m.

deploy-bot: Canary hold cleared for manual retry. Recommended next step: start canary at 10% with patched config and observe for 1h before continuing.

diana: agreed. new release window confirmed 03:30 UTC. @ops-bot please update calendar and notify oncall.

ops-bot: Calendar updated: release window moved to 03:30 UTC, change_window_id=cw-782. Notifications sent to oncall and release owners. :white_check_mark:

diana: closing this thread; create a follow-up if we see regression after resumed canary. thanks everyone. :clap:
